# Partner Market Global

> Curated B2B showcase connecting companies that have import, export, distribution, franchise, licensing, private label / OEM, and country partner opportunities with qualified international partners. Operated by Alex de Vries of De Vries Sales Consultancy. 100% commission-based — no listing fees, no upfront subscription packages.

Canonical site: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com
Official contact: info@partnermarketglobal.com
Last updated: 2026-08-19
Languages: English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de), Dutch (nl), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt), Chinese (zh), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Arabic (ar), Hindi (hi), Russian (ru) — all routes available under /{locale}/.

## What Partner Market Global Is

Partner Market Global is a curated commercial opportunity showcase, not an unverified open directory. Every listing is reviewed, verified and structured into a consistent commercial profile covering: opportunity type, sector, origin country, target markets, ideal partner profile, commercial model, territory availability, investment/working-capital expectations, credentials, available documents, risk notes, and structured qualification workflows.

Opportunity types covered:
- Import Opportunities: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/import-opportunities/
- Export Opportunities: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/export-opportunities/
- Distribution Rights: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/distribution-rights/
- Franchise Opportunities: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/franchise-opportunities/
- Master Franchise Rights: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/master-franchise-opportunities/
- Licensing Opportunities: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/licensing-opportunities/
- Private Label / OEM Opportunities: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/private-label-oem-opportunities/
- Country Partner Opportunities: https://www.partnermarketglobal.com/en/country-partner-opportunities/

Commercial model: 100% commission-based. Commission scope, trigger, territory, and timing are agreed in writing before representation starts. Browsing and submitting qualified inquiries is free for prospective international partners.

## Primary Routes & Hubs

- /en/ — platform overview, featured global opportunities, and FAQ
- /en/opportunities/ — all curated business opportunity listings with multi-attribute search and filters
- /en/opportunities/[slug]/ — individual opportunity profile with description, credentials, partner requirements, risk notes, and server-side inquiry qualification form
- /en/japan/ — JIP Japan hub: pre-screened Japanese commercial partnerships, distribution rights, and franchise listings
- /en/list-your-opportunity/ — for companies seeking international distributors, retail listings, franchisees, or commercial partners
- /en/submit-opportunity/ — multi-step opportunity submission portal
- /en/commercial-terms/ — commission-based commercial terms available on inquiry
- /en/curation-process/ — review, verification, and curation methodology
- /en/about/ — platform story and De Vries Sales Consultancy operator context
- /en/contact/ — official inquiry and contact portal
- /en/privacy-policy/ — privacy, consent, and GDPR-compliant data handling policy
- /en/terms/ — terms of use and commercial disclaimers

## Who Should Use Partner Market Global

- **Importers, Wholesalers & Distributors**: Sourcing pre-vetted international brands with exclusive territory potential.
- **National Retail Chains & Department Stores**: Direct access to manufacturers for consumer goods, toys, food, and lifestyle products.
- **Multi-Unit Operators & Franchisees**: Evaluating proven Japanese and Asian restaurant and service concepts.
- **Private Label & OEM Buyers**: Connecting with audited manufacturing facilities.
- **Brand Owners & Principals**: Appointing qualified representation across Europe, Southeast Asia, and global markets.
